recentItems.title: 'This is a violation': Imee kinuwestiyon ang 'overdue' na puwesto ni Dizon sa DPWH
recentItems.description:
Kinuwestiyon ni Sen. Imee Marcos ngayong Biyernes, Setyembre 25, ang pananatili ni Vince Dizon bilang acting secretary ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), matapos igiit na isang taon lamang ang limitasyon sa temporary designation sa ilalim ng Administrative Code.

Sinabi naman ni Dizon na kailangan niya munang kumonsulta sa Office of the President hinggil sa status at legal na batayan ng kaniyang appointment.

recentItems.title: Why postponing BSKE is 'very wrong, unreasonable' according to election lawyer
recentItems.description:
Veteran election lawyer Romulo Macalintal on Friday (September 25) criticized the postponement of the 2026 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections, calling the move “very wrong” and “unreasonable.”

President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday signed Republic Act No. 12326, extending the terms of incumbent barangay and SK officials from four to five years and moving the elections scheduled for November 2, 2026, to November 2028.

recentItems.title: Sara Duterte on voting threshold, Baste’s subpoena, whether she’ll face trial
recentItems.description:
Vice President Sara Duterte said on Friday (September 25) that she is leaving it to her defense team to comment on the lowering of the conviction threshold in her impeachment trial.



She said she is aware of the petition filed by former Executive Secretary Atty. Vic Rodriguez before the Supreme Court questioning the decision of the Senate impeachment court.



Duterte was also asked about the possibility of attending her impeachment trial, saying the presence of her lawyers would already mean her appearance and participation in the proceedings.



“Well, depende. Wala pa namang pagpapatawag sa akin. Sabi ko nga, ang impeachment ay isang legal na process. At ‘yung pagpunta ng aking mga abugado doon ay iyon ‘yung aking appearance at participation doon sa proseso na yon,” she said.



Duterte added she has no information yet on whether her younger brother, Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, will attend the impeachment trial after he was subpoenaed by the impeachment court. — Report from Hernel Tocmo, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Lawyer: Romualdez to testify in own plunder trial
recentItems.description:
Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez himself will testify in the Sandiganbayan Third Division’s plunder trial against him, his lawyer Ade Fajardo said on Friday (September 25).

The former House speaker has been detained at the Quezon City Jail over the alleged P7.4-billion kickback scheme in government projects. His co-accused include former congressman and fugitive Zaldy Co.

Fajardo also said Co’s purported bagmen who recanted that they delivered suitcases of kickback money to Romualdez could also be presented as witness. — Report from Daniza Fernandez, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: #QueeniePH lalakas, pero mapapaaga ang paglabas ng PAR
recentItems.description:
Weather update (September 25, 5 p.m.): Queenie is nearing severe tropical storm strength. At 4 p.m. Friday, it was located 745 kilometers east of Basco, Batanes.



It now packs winds of 85 kph with gustiness up to 105 kph and is moving west northwestward at 20 kph.



Queenie will remain far from land while inside the PAR. It may recurve east of Taiwan during the weekend.



It may intensify into a typhoon before it exits the Philippine area of responsibility on Sunday afternoon or evening, September 27. — Report from Ariel Rojas, ABS-CBN News
